column2: Collapse of French Rule in Algeria

§RGain 2.5 infamy§! In ancient times, the Sami people once extended further south into Scandinavia. Although we had been pushed back by the Norse, we still remember the lands of our ancestors. Let us reclaim them, for the glory of Sapmi!
§RGain 1 infamy§! Part of Karelia lies in Finnish territory. We should lay claim to it, in order to unite Karelia, and with it all Karelians.
§RGain 5 infamy§! The Ingrian Finns are our close relatives, but lie under the Russian boot. We should lay claim to Ingria, to free our brothers and  gain control over a strategic economic hub.
§RGain 5 infamy§! Our ancestral Uralic brethren, the Samoyedic and Eastern Finnic peoples, must be united under our banner!
